text:
Jo P: Quick askan we run a 2-hour 'kudos mini-stand' by the south entrance next Tue 11-1? small cards + instant stickers, folks can drop a note for someone.
Ava (People Ops): Sounds great. Low lift. How many kits?
Jo P: Thinking 60 kits (cards + 2 stickers each). Volunteers to staff and a QR fallback for remote folks.
Ethan R: I can staff 11-12. Lily 12-1?
Lily Z: Yep I can do 12-1. I have a tablet for QR form.
Ava (People Ops): I'll approve up to $120 for supplies. MailroomBot, can you schedule pickup of envelopes and sticky pads?
MailroomBot: Supplies ticket #11002 logged. ETA pickup 24h.
Jo P: I'll draft a 2-line poster: "Kudos Mini-Stand — 11-1 Tue. Give a quick note, leave a sticker." Will post assets here.
Ava (People Ops): Manager nudge? I'll send a short manager ping to encourage teams to swing by.
Jo P: Added runbook: setup 10:45, table near south entrance, drop completed cards to Mailroom by 2pm.
Ava (People Ops): Great. Closing items: kits ordered, volunteers set, QR form ready. See you Tuesday! :sparkles:
